title: Influence bound from quarter switching
statement: Assume every Boolean function on a finite-dimensional sign cube that has a DNF or CNF representation of positive width at most $w$ has probability at most $(1/4)^k$ of having restricted decision-tree depth at least $k$, under a random restriction that leaves each coordinate free with probability $1/(20w)$. If a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube is computed by a depth-$d$ circuit of size at most $s$ for some width, then its total influence is at most $4\bigl(20(\lceil\log_2(s+1)\rceil+2)\bigr)^{d-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: The quarter switching bound for all dimensions, positive widths, qualifying DNF or CNF representations, and natural numbers $k$
A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
Existence of a depth-$d$, size-at-most-$s$ circuit for the function, with some width
